differences.title: 1. PERFORMANCE
differences.leftDesc: Leverages Vite's native ESM support and esbuild for lightning-fast startup and HMR, running tests directly in the browser.
differences.rightDesc: Bundles code with Babel/TypeScript, leading to slower startup times but robust ecosystem for complex transformations.

differences.title: 2. CONFIGURATION
differences.leftDesc: Uses Vite's configuration by default, minimal setup required for most projects, highly integrated with Vite ecosystem.
differences.rightDesc: Requires explicit configuration, often with `jest.config.js`, offering extensive customization but with a steeper learning curve.

differences.title: 3. RUNTIME
differences.leftDesc: Runs tests directly in the browser using native ESM, allowing for more realistic testing environments and faster feedback loops.
differences.rightDesc: Executes tests in a Node.js VM, transforming code via Babel/TypeScript, which can sometimes mask environment differences.

differences.title: 4. TRANSFORMATIONS
differences.leftDesc: Relies on Vite's optimized transformation pipeline (esbuild, SWC) for speed, focusing on efficient module resolution.
differences.rightDesc: Uses Babel or TypeScript compiler for code transpilation, providing flexibility but adding overhead to test execution.

differences.title: 5. MOCKING
differences.leftDesc: Leverages native ESM `import` assertions and experimental `--experimental-vm-modules` for mocking, aligning with modern JS standards.
differences.rightDesc: Features a powerful, built-in mocking API (`jest.mock`) that intercepts module dependencies effectively.

differences.title: 6. COMMUNITY & ECOSYSTEM
differences.leftDesc: Rapidly gaining traction, especially within the Vite community, with active development and increasing plugin support.
differences.rightDesc: Vast, mature ecosystem with extensive community support, numerous plugins, and a long history of adoption.

differences.title: 7. TYPESCRIPT SUPPORT
differences.leftDesc: Provides excellent out-of-the-box TypeScript support leveraging Vite's native compilation, often requiring minimal configuration.
differences.rightDesc: Requires explicit configuration with `@babel/preset-typescript` or `ts-jest` to transpile TypeScript code.
